new_statements.rule_in_words: Word stress is predictable (non-contrastive) and falls on the final syllable of the word; the only stated exception is when the final syllable consists of a bare vowel (syllable type V, i.e. an onsetless, codaless vowel such as the final a of au.a 'different'), in which case stress is not final (by implication it retracts to the penult, though the OPD does not say where it goes). Stress conditions schwa quality ([ʌ] stressed vs [ə]/[i] unstressed).
new_statements.exceptions: Final stress does not apply 'when the last syllable is V' (a word-final onsetless open vowel syllable); the landing site in that case is not stated.
new_statements.domain_note: Stated for the 'word'; OPD is a 4-page SIL summary sheet marked 'Draft (posted as is without peer review)'; no tone or contrastive length reported. Woodward 1978 treats only phrase/pause-group intonation and does not bear on word stress.
new_statements.identity_note: The OPD describes Maring [MBW] of the Jimi valley, 'Mt. Hagen - Western Highlands Province', major villages Kombiai (Kompiai), Bokopai, Kwima, Togbane; Woodward's fieldwork base was Kompiai village. This is Glottolog mari1435 (PNG Maring), not the Tibeto-Burman Maring Naga [nng] nor Australian Maringarr [zmt]. No dialect is singled out.
